name: generate_image
description: 🎨 Generate AI images with Google Gemini 3 (Nano Banana Pro). Create pictures, artwork, infographics, visualizations. Use when user says 'generate an image', 'create a picture', 'make artwork', 'draw', 'visualize'. SUPPORTS GROUNDING: Set use_grounding=true for real-time data like weather infographics, stock charts, current events. Example: 'Create an infographic of today's weather in Portland' with use_grounding=true. Images save to stash for email, print, canvas, PDF. Supports 4K resolution, multiple aspect ratios.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image. Be specific about subject, colors, mood, composition. Example: 'A cozy coffee shop with warm lighting, plants, and a cat on a chair'

aspect_ratio.description: Image shape: 'square' (1:1), 'landscape' (16:9 - wallpapers, banners), 'portrait' (9:16 - phone backgrounds, infographics), 'wide' (21:9 - cinematic), or exact ratios like '4:3', '3:2'

use_grounding.description: 🌐 Enable Google Search grounding for REAL-TIME data. Use for: weather infographics, stock charts, current events, sports scores, news visualizations. Gemini searches the web first, then generates accurate imagery.

style.description: Art style: photorealistic, anime, watercolor, oil painting, sketch, digital art, 3D render, pixel art, comic book, impressionist, minimalist, cyberpunk, fantasy, infographic

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid: 'blurry, low quality, text, watermark, distorted'

context_data.description: Data from other Jarvis tools to incorporate into the image. Example: weather data, crypto prices, system stats. Jarvis can chain tools: get data first, then pass it here for visualization.

save.description: Save to stash for use with email/print/canvas/PDF (default: true)
